title: FanOutSelection
description: DSL 3.1 preview selection document a selective parallel freezes before any branch starts. It names the optional branches that run; non-optional branches always run. Unknown and duplicate names are rejected when the runner freezes the document.

branches.description: Selected branches. An empty array runs only the non-optional branches.

name.description: Name of a branch declared by the selective parallel.

reason.description: Optional human-facing reason, at most 512 bytes. Journaled and displayed, but excluded from conformance comparison.
